Solve using quadratic formula: x = [-b ± sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)]/(2a). Here discriminant D = b^2 - 4ac = 4 - 12 = -8 < 0. So complex solutions: x = (-2 ± sqrt(-8))/(2) = (-2 ± i*sqrt(8))/2 = (-2 ± i*2*sqrt(2))/2 = -1 ± i*sqrt(2). So solutions: x = -1 + i√2 and x = -1 - i√2.
